review: 701.19b-1: the one_shield_only delta left the timing of the activation open; it now names the response to the first Doom Blade.

scenarios.title: A regeneration shield replaces the next destruction this turn
decisions: A casts Doom Blade targeting Cudgel Troll, tapping two Swamps.
A passes priority; B activates Cudgel Troll's regenerate ability, tapping Forest.
Both players pass; the regeneration ability resolves and creates a shield.
Both players pass; Doom Blade resolves.

variants.label: shielded
variants.expected: Doom Blade's destruction is replaced: Cudgel Troll stays on the battlefield, tapped, with all damage removed.

variants.label: no_shield
variants.delta: B does not activate Cudgel Troll's regenerate ability.
variants.expected: Cudgel Troll is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

operation.unclassifiable: a different decision by a player (B does not activate the ability)

variants.label: shield_used_up
variants.delta: After the first Doom Blade resolves, A casts the second Doom Blade on Cudgel Troll, tapping the other two Swamps, and B does not activate the ability again.
variants.expected: The first Doom Blade is regenerated. The shield was used up by the first destruction, so the second Doom Blade destroys Cudgel Troll and it moves to B's graveyard.

operation.unclassifiable: adds a second spell cast and changes player decisions

detector.outcome: A destroy effect resolves and the target permanent regenerates instead of being destroyed (a regenerated event in the resolution's effect half).
detector.near_miss: A destroy effect resolves with no regenerated event: the permanent is destroyed.

scenarios.title: A regenerated blocker is tapped, healed and removed from combat
decisions: A attacks player B with Halberdier.
B blocks Halberdier with Cudgel Troll.
B activates Cudgel Troll's regenerate ability, tapping Forest; both players pass and the shield is created.
Both players pass; the first-strike combat damage step begins.

variants.label: shielded
variants.expected: Halberdier (3/1, first strike) deals 3 first-strike damage to Cudgel Troll (4/3). The destruction is replaced: Cudgel Troll becomes tapped, its damage is removed and it is removed from combat, so it deals no regular combat damage. Halberdier survives undamaged. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: no_shield
variants.delta: B does not activate the regenerate ability.
variants.expected: Halberdier deals 3 first-strike damage to Cudgel Troll, which is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard before dealing damage. Halberdier survives undamaged. B's life stays 20.

operation.unclassifiable: a different decision by a player (B does not activate the ability)

detector.outcome: A creature in combat that would be destroyed regenerates: a regenerated event in the damage step.
detector.near_miss: A creature dealt lethal combat damage with no shield is destroyed instead (no regenerated event); the detector tags the fires side only.

scenarios.title: A static regeneration ability replaces every destruction
decisions: A casts Doom Blade targeting Mossbridge Troll, tapping two Swamps; both players pass and it resolves.
A casts the second Doom Blade targeting Mossbridge Troll, tapping the other two Swamps; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: static_regeneration
variants.expected: Both destructions are replaced by regeneration: Mossbridge Troll stays on the battlefield, tapped, with no damage, after each Doom Blade.

variants.label: one_shield_only
variants.delta: B's creature is Cudgel Troll, whose regeneration is a shield from an activated ability, and B activates it once (tapping Forest) in response to the first Doom Blade.
variants.expected: The first Doom Blade is regenerated; the second finds no shield and destroys Cudgel Troll, which moves to B's graveyard.

operation.unclassifiable: changes the card and B's activation decision (more than one fact)

detector.outcome: A destroy event meets a destruction replacement, such as a static regeneration ability, and is replaced: the permanent stays on the battlefield.
detector.near_miss: A destroy event meets a destruction replacement and is not replaced.

scenarios.title: A regeneration shield can be created under can't-be-regenerated, but it does not apply
decisions: A casts Terror targeting Cudgel Troll, tapping both Swamps.
A passes priority; B activates Cudgel Troll's regenerate ability, tapping Forest.
Both players pass; the regeneration ability resolves and creates a shield.

variants.label: terror
variants.expected: B's activation is legal and the shield is created, but Terror's destruction can't be regenerated: Cudgel Troll is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: doom_blade
variants.delta: A casts Doom Blade instead of Terror.
variants.expected: The shield applies: Cudgel Troll stays on the battlefield, tapped, with damage removed.

detector.outcome: A destruction that cannot be regenerated destroys the permanent, whatever shield it holds (a destroyed event marked not regenerable).
detector.near_miss: A destruction that can be regenerated and is regenerated instead; no clean near miss without an api filter, so only the fires side is tagged.
